content: The BC Cancer Agency is an integral part of the Provincial Health Services Authority in British Columbia, Canada. The Agency is driven by a mission that encompasses three primary objectives: 1. To decrease the incidence of cancer within the population. 2. To lower the mortality rate associated with cancer. 3. To enhance the quality of life for individuals living with cancer. The BC Cancer Agency operates four regional cancer care centres, as well as the BC Cancer Research Centre, which has departments located in both Vancouver and Victoria. The Agency is responsible for delivering nearly all radiotherapy services across British Columbia and provides the majority of chemotherapy treatments in the province. Furthermore, the Agency offers specialized prostate brachytherapy services to patients in the province of Saskatchewan. The BC Cancer Foundation, an independent charitable organization, supports the research and care initiatives undertaken by the BC Cancer Agency.
